boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner combinatorics and software evidence only; not independent reproduction, empirical GMUT, production THOS or Freed ID, identity continuity, consciousness, personhood, AGI or ASI, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, complete privacy, security or accessibility assurance, a Theory-of-Everything proof, canon, or Stage 20 readiness.

mechanisms.description: Normalize a finite directed network with one source, one sink and positive integer capacities.
mechanisms.name: network-envelope

mechanisms.description: Determine exact directed reachability from the source and retain the sink witness.
mechanisms.name: source-sink-reachability

mechanisms.description: Enumerate every finite simple source-to-sink path under the frozen vertex cap.
mechanisms.name: simple-path-census

mechanisms.description: Enumerate every source-side vertex subset that excludes the sink.
mechanisms.name: cut-enumeration

mechanisms.description: Compute exact integer capacity for every enumerated source-sink cut.
mechanisms.name: cut-capacity-profile

mechanisms.description: Select every minimum-capacity cut and preserve its crossing-arc certificate.
mechanisms.name: minimum-cut-certificate

mechanisms.description: Compute an integral maximum flow with deterministic breadth-first augmenting paths.
mechanisms.name: augmenting-path-flow

mechanisms.description: Verify capacity bounds and exact conservation at each nonterminal vertex.
mechanisms.name: flow-conservation

mechanisms.description: Compare the augmenting-path flow value with exhaustive cut enumeration.
mechanisms.name: maxflow-mincut-agreement

mechanisms.description: Recompute the finite flow value after deleting each declared arc.
mechanisms.name: edge-deletion-sensitivity

mechanisms.description: Decompose the integral flow into exact source-to-sink path components.
mechanisms.name: flow-decomposition

mechanisms.description: Recover a minimum cut from residual reachability and compare its capacity with the flow value.
mechanisms.name: residual-cut-certificate

mechanisms.description: Count and retain all minimum cuts rather than silently selecting one.
mechanisms.name: minimum-cut-multiplicity

mechanisms.description: Scale all capacities by two and verify exact finite flow scaling.
mechanisms.name: capacity-scaling

mechanisms.description: Relabel internal vertices bijectively while preserving source and sink and verify the flow value.
mechanisms.name: vertex-relabel-invariance

mechanisms.description: Increase one capacity and verify that the maximum-flow value does not decrease.
mechanisms.name: capacity-monotonicity

mechanisms.description: Record vertex count, exact maximum-flow value and minimum-cut multiplicity.
mechanisms.name: three-coordinate-model

mechanisms.description: Represent a bounded flow-and-cut analogy without promoting it to physical correspondence.
mechanisms.name: gmut-analogy

mechanisms.description: Retain the absence of real networks, measurements, uncertainty models and independent review.
mechanisms.name: external-observation-gap

mechanisms.description: Hold live routing, infrastructure, safety and allocation decisions behind competent authority.
mechanisms.name: deployment-authority-gate
